exposure: drone delivery of automated external defibrillators (AEDs)
outcome: median time benefit achieved by drone deliveries
percentage of attached drone-delivered AEDs before ambulance arrival
percentage of cases defibrillated by a drone-delivered AED when used before ambulance arrival
cohort: The study included alerts for suspected out-of-hospital cardiac arrests in areas covering approximately 200,000 inhabitants in Sweden, excluding cases involving children younger than 8 years, trauma, and EMS-witnessed events.
finding: AED-equipped drones dispatched for suspected out-of-hospital cardiac arrests delivered AEDs before ambulance arrival in 67% of cases, with a median time benefit of 3 minutes and 14 seconds.
